#### ADOCS-02 · تدقيق CLAUDE.md وAGENTS.md وتخفيف السياق · Audit CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md for context diet · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يدقق ملفات سياق الوكلاء في المستودع، وينقل المحتوى الدائم الثقيل إلى مهارات عند الطلب أو وثائق مرتبطة، ويزامن ملفات التعليمات بين الأدوات من مصدر واحد. — Audit repository agent-context files, move always-loaded bulk into on-demand skills or linked docs, and keep per-tool instruction files in sync from one source.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** CLAUDE.md feels bloated or ignored, an agent repeats the same project mistake, quality drops in long sessions, or the team wants one instruction source for several AI tools.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Inventory CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules, Copilot instructions and .claude/rules. 2) Classify each block: always-needed, task-specific (make it a skill), heavy reference (link a doc), or delegated work (subagent). 3) Cut long or ignored sections; keep short, testable rules about repeated mistakes. 4) Add pointers so every context file stays small and loads on demand. 5) Generate per-tool files from one config (AGENTS.md from a sources list) and verify they match. 6) Capture recurring corrections as new rules. **أرقام / params:** repo path; target tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot); size budget
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3047-adlc-context/13100-agent-context-files` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2134-agent-patterns-plugin/7575-meta-context-diet` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2815-agent-sync/11429-agent-sync`

#### ADOCS-03 · مزامنة ذاكرة التعليمات دون تضخم مع تحقق مستقل · Non-growth instruction-memory sync with independent verify · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** توليد مهارة مزامنة ذاكرة محلية تقارن CLAUDE.md والقواعد وملفات الوكلاء بالشيفرة، فتصلح الحقائق القديمة أولاً ثم تزيل التكرار وتضغط دون أن يكبر أي ملف، مع وكلاء تحقق مستقلين. — Generate a project-local memory-sync skill that diffs CLAUDE.md, rules and agent files against the code, repairs stale facts first, then dedups and compresses so no file grows, with separate verifier agents re-checking every edit.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** CLAUDE.md or rules drifted from the code; too much always-loaded context; after a branch or commit range changed behavior; requests like 'sync memory', 'slim context', 'clean up agent config'.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Resolve the mode (status|install|upgrade|...|purge) from the prompt; print a PLAN block; ask only if destructive. 2) Enumerate the memory surface by command; split into disjoint batches. 3) GATHER: read-only agents list change facts for the scope (session|branch|commit|all). 4) SYNC: one bounded agent per batch, all spawned in one message; facts first, dedup second, compression third; every file ends at or below its line count. 5) VERIFY: a different read-only agent per edited batch re-checks each fact in code and that removed facts are gone. 6) HARD depth: audit rule path globs (TOO_BROAD/TOO_NARROW/DANGLING/MISSING) and purge what a model already knows. 7) Report in chat only. **أرقام / params:** scope (session|branch|commit <sha>|recent:N|all); depth (NORMAL|HARD); reach (MEMORY|REFS); free-text emphasis
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`git`](../requirements.md#req-git) · [`claude:tools`](../requirements.md#req-claude-tools)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT (no copyleft seen among supporting ids); the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2096-brewdoc/7431-memory-sync-setup` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2098-brewtools/7442-context-slim` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/945-clean-up-agent-config/2230-clean-up-agent-config`

## واجهات API والخلفية — APIs, backends & auth

#### ADOCS-04 · إعداد تقرير TPAR للمقاولين في أستراليا · Australian TPAR contractor report prep · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يعد تفصيل TPAR السنوي بتحديد المقاولين وفحص ABN وفصل ضريبة GST وتسجيل الأخطاء في ورقة عمل. — Prepare an annual TPAR breakdown: identify reportable contractors, validate ABNs, split GST and log errors in a working paper.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Australian client in a reportable industry needs the contractor payments report.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Pull a full year of supplier bills and direct payments. 2) Filter by reportable industries (construction, cleaning, courier, IT, road freight, security); mixed businesses apply the 10% of GST turnover test. 3) Validate ABN: 11 digits plus check digit. 4) Separate GST; report gross. 5) Aggregate per contractor (gross, GST, net, count, first/last date). 6) Error sweep: missing ABN, duplicates, employees in AP, materials-only. 7) Word working paper; deadline 28 August. **أرقام / params:** financial year, industry
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`pip:office`](../requirements.md#req-pip-office)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ADOCS-07 · مراجعة مخاطر العقود واتفاقيات السرية · Contract and NDA risk review with redline · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يقرأ العقد كاملاً ويصنّفه ويقيّم بنوده في ثماني فئات مخاطر ويقترح تعديلات، ويصوغ اتفاقية سرية. — Read a contract fully, classify it, score clauses across eight risk categories and propose redlines; also draft an NDA.

#### ADOCS-08 · مراجعة العقود بدليل بنود ومستويات مخاطر · Contract review with clause playbook and tiers · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يراجع العقد مقابل مواقف البنود المعيارية والبديلة والمرفوضة ويصنف الانحرافات ويستخرج الشروط. — Review a contract against standard/fallback/walk-away clause positions, flag material deviations by tier and extract key terms.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Incoming contract, NDA triage, redlines, approval routing.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Ingest file (PDF/DOCX/TXT) and classify type. 2) Compare against clause library (liability, indemnity, IP, term, confidentiality). 3) Tier each deviation: within fallback, beyond fallback, walk-away; route to approver. 4) Optionally run parallel lenses (risk, plain-English, missing protections, compliance) and aggregate a 0-100 safety score. 5) Extract parties, value, dates, cap, governing law, renewal into schema. 6) State not legal advice. **أرقام / params:** contract text, playbook
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`python3`](../requirements.md#req-python3)

#### ADOCS-11 · مخطط علاقات الكيانات من ملفات المخطط · Offline ER diagram from schema declarations · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** ارسم مخطط ERD من تعريفات المخطط المخزنة دون اتصال بقاعدة البيانات. — Draw a Mermaid or DBML ERD from Prisma models, EF mappings or SQL migrations without a DB connection, tracing every entity to a file.

## التصحيح — Debugging & diagnosis

#### ADOCS-12 · مراجعة ما بعد الحادث بلا لوم · Blameless postmortem with timeline and action items · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يكتب مراجعة بلا لوم بالجدول الزمني والسبب الجذري وبنود عمل متتبعة. — Writes a blameless postmortem: timeline, root cause, contributing factors and tracked actions.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** After SEV1/SEV2, outage over 15 min, data loss, or near-miss.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Draft within 1-2 days, meeting days 3-5, finalize day 5-7. 2) Frame as what conditions allowed it. 3) Timeline, impact, root cause plus contributing factors. 4) Action items with owner and due date. 5) Review patterns quarterly.

- **ماذا / what:** جمّع حزمة دعم دنيا قائمة على قائمة سماح مع تنقيح موثّق وبصمات ومسؤول حذف. — Assemble a minimal allowlist-based support bundle with verified redaction, hashes and a deletion owner.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Escalating to vendor support or incident review with logs/config involved.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Define incident window, service, audience, retention, custodian. 2) Write allowlist manifest and forbidden field classes first. 3) Collect versions, config key presence (not values), status/error class, request IDs, timing, retry history. 4) Synthetic repro with expected vs observed. 5) Run secret/URL/PII canary scan on all output; abort if any survives. 6) Hash bundle, log redactions and gaps, schedule deletion. **أرقام / params:** service, incident window, audience
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ADOCS-36 · شجرة اختيار مسار FDA للأجهزة الطبية · FDA device pathway selection decision tree · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** اختيار مسار 510(k) أو De Novo أو PMA حسب وجود جهاز مرجعي ودرجة الخطورة وتخطيط اجتماع ما قبل التقديم. — Choose 510(k) / De Novo / PMA from predicate availability and risk, then plan a Pre-Sub.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Medical device team asks which FDA route, timeline or fee applies.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Identify product code and class. 2) Search 510(k) database for predicates. 3) Branch: predicate+equivalent -> 510(k) (abbreviated/special/traditional by change type); novel low-moderate risk -> De Novo; Class III -> PMA. 4) Tabulate timeline and user fee, flag fee year. 5) Draft Q-Sub questions and schedule Pre-Sub. Output is a recommendation for regulatory review. **أرقام / params:** device description, intended use, candidate predicates
